review_scope: Local connection, curvature, gauge transformation, and differential-form foundations; reviewed as a connected prerequisite subgraph.
review_status_note: The 80 records whose evidence begins 'Reviewed source opening:' are triage notes from excerpt inspection, not full semantic reviews. They are retained for queueing and must not be counted as completed review until audited from the full source.

reviews.evidence: Characteristic classes are constructed from curvature, so characteristic-class was a consequence edge in this overview and was removed.
The operator is defined on differential forms and its Leibniz law uses the wedge product; both are genuine foundations.

The lemma explicitly applies the local gauge transformation law for A; that law is a direct prerequisite. Its formulas now consistently use the Lie-bracket convention 1/2[A wedge A] for arbitrary Lie groups, reserving matrix A wedge A for the matrix example.

The core definition pulls a principal connection form back along a local section. Gauge and curvature laws are later consequences/applications, so they were removed from prerequisites; the section concept was made explicit.
The local form is defined from the principal curvature and local connection form. The gauge-transform knowl is needed only for a later transformation paragraph, not the definition.

This is the principal-connection structure equation. The generic curvature overview imported vector-bundle and Chern-Weil material unnecessarily; the specific principal curvature 2-form and connection form are the correct foundations.
The definition explicitly covers smooth real or complex vector bundles; complex-vector-bundle was an overly narrow prerequisite.
The corollary applies invariant polynomials to a principal curvature 2-form; the generic curvature overview was an indirect and overly broad prerequisite.
The pullback identity is stated for the principal curvature 2-form; use the specific curvature form knowl rather than the broad overview.
Chern-Simons gauge behavior uses the curvature 2-form of a principal connection directly; the generic curvature overview added unrelated vector-bundle branches.
The theorem is formulated using the principal curvature 2-form; the generic curvature overview was an indirect prerequisite.
The Bianchi identity is the covariant differential identity for the principal curvature 2-form, so the specific form is the direct prerequisite.
The pullback theorem's curvature identity concerns the principal curvature 2-form directly; the broad curvature overview is unnecessary.
The Chern character here is built from End(E)-valued curvature of a vector-bundle connection, so the specific vector curvature definition is the direct prerequisite.
Chern forms are constructed from curvature of a complex vector-bundle connection; the specific vector curvature knowl is the appropriate foundation.
Pontryagin forms use curvature of a real vector-bundle connection and its complexification; the generic curvature overview is unnecessarily broad.
The Euler form uses curvature of a compatible vector-bundle connection; the specific curvature definition is the direct foundation.
Integrality is stated for curvature of a complex vector-bundle connection; the vector curvature definition is the direct prerequisite.

The theorem assumes a Riemannian manifold and identifies the Levi-Civita connection on the tangent bundle with a principal connection on the orthonormal frame bundle; those concepts are direct prerequisites.
The equation is the principal connection curvature structure equation and directly uses a connection 1-form, curvature 2-form, exterior derivative, wedge, and Lie algebra.
The definition starts with a principal bundle and local section, so both were missing direct foundations.
The lemma transforms a local connection form obtained from a local section of a principal connection; the connection-form and section concepts were missing direct prerequisites.
The definition explicitly begins with a principal G-bundle; that direct prerequisite was missing.

Full source defines closed k-forms as the kernel of the exterior derivative on differential forms over a smooth manifold; smooth manifold, differential k-form, and exterior derivative are the direct defining prerequisites, with no downstream theorem needed.

Full source constructs a bundle by gluing trivial pieces with a smooth Lie-group-valued overlap map; open covers and the Lie group are direct foundations, while the transition-function knowl is the resulting construction, so the reviewed prerequisite set is correct.

Full source defines the dual action by lambda composed with Ad of g inverse; Lie-group adjoint action, its Lie algebra, and vector-space dual linear algebra are direct foundations. A cotangent-bundle prerequisite would be an analogy rather than a dependency and was removed.

Full source states identity, inverse, and triple-overlap composition for bundle transition maps; bundle atlas, typical fiber, transition function, and smooth fiber bundle directly supply those notions.
Full source defines compact support from the closure of the nonzero locus of a vector-bundle section; vector bundle, section, support, compact set, and vector-space structure are all used directly.
Full source defines a vector bundle with complex fibers and complex-linear transition functions over a smooth manifold; smooth manifold, vector bundle, and rank are the direct prerequisites.
Full source defines g acting on G by h mapping to ghg inverse and identifies its differential with the adjoint action; Lie group, diffeomorphism, and adjoint action directly support the definition.

Full source defines a Lie-algebra-valued connection 1-form with reproduction and right-equivariance on a principal bundle; differential-k-form was missing and was added, while the convention, fundamental-vector, reproduction, adjoint, and vertical prerequisites match each condition.

Full source restricts a principal connection to an H-reduction and requires the structure group inclusion H into G; Lie subgroup, reduction, principal bundle, and connection are exactly the defining prerequisites.

Full source gives the Koszul connection operator on vector-bundle sections and vector fields, including the Leibniz rule; the listed vector bundle, smooth manifold, section module, vector field, and Leibniz prerequisites are direct.
Full source induces connections on exterior and symmetric powers from a vector-bundle connection via the tensor-product connection; every listed prerequisite is used in that construction.
Full source forms P times G modulo G using conjugation, producing the adjoint associated bundle; principal bundle, Lie group, associated-bundle construction, and conjugation action are direct.
Full source forms P times the Lie algebra modulo the adjoint action and uses its bracket; principal bundle, Lie group, Lie algebra, associated bundle, and Lie bracket directly cover the construction.

Full source defines the quotient (P times F)/G for a left G-space and the induced bundle projection; the principal bundle, Lie group, associated-bundle, action convention, and smooth action prerequisites are all direct.

Full source constructs TP/G, its anchor to TM, bracket on invariant vector fields, and the exact sequence; tangent bundle, vector bundle, vector fields, Lie bracket, quotient, and short exact sequence are direct.

Full source varies two principal connections and derives the characteristic-form transgression; principal connection/form, curvature, Chern-Weil form/theorem, tensorial difference, Cartan equation, and invariance corollary are all used.
Full source lifts a vector-bundle connection to the frame bundle and obtains the principal connection; vector bundle, smooth manifold, vector connection, and frame-bundle construction are direct.

Full source applies the derived representation to the principal curvature to compute associated-bundle curvature; principal connection, principal curvature 2-form, Lie-group representation, and induced covariant derivative are direct and are now all listed.
Full source builds the frame bundle from local frames of a rank-n vector bundle and its local trivializations; vector bundle, smooth manifold, and local trivialization directly support it.

Full source transforms transition functions and local connection forms under a change of local sections; principal bundle/connection, transition functions, local connection and gauge transformation are exactly the direct prerequisites.

Full source defines the holonomy element by principal parallel transport around a based loop and places it in the holonomy group; principal bundle, connection, parallel transport, and holonomy group directly support it.
Full source states existence and uniqueness of horizontal lifts of base curves for a principal connection; principal bundle, connection, horizontal distribution, and parallel transport are direct.

Full source descends the principal horizontal distribution to an associated bundle and obtains an Ehresmann/vector-bundle connection; all listed principal, associated, horizontal, Ehresmann, and vector-connection prerequisites are used.

Full source differentiates an equivariant representative of a smooth associated-bundle section along a horizontal lift; section-of-a-fiber-bundle and horizontal-lift-of-a-tangent-vector were added to the existing direct prerequisites.

The definition evaluates a form on pushed-forward tangent vectors. Wedge, exterior derivative, closed/exact forms, cohomology, diffeomorphisms, and embeddings occur only in later properties/examples and were removed from the minimal prerequisites.

The definition is fiberwise duality using local trivializations. The vector-bundle-morphism appears only in a later functoriality paragraph, so it is a consequence/application rather than a prerequisite.

The definition itself supplies typical fiber and local trivialization as parts of the vector-bundle structure. Listing those definition components as prerequisites created a cycle through smooth-fiber-bundle; they were removed while retaining the underlying smooth bundle and linear algebra.
